build_dataflow_graph: build a dataflow graph by adding nodes and edges then calling canonicalize to validate structure
build_line_graph: build a line graph from an existing dataflow graph to represent edge-to-edge dependencies
build_dominator_tree: build a dominator tree from a dataflow graph and query lowest common ancestors of nodes
prune_graph: prune copy nodes from a dataflow graph using aggressive mode to remove unnecessary edges
find_nodes_and_edges: find nodes or edges in a dataflow graph by name pattern op_type or group_id
